Profile · 01
Operating where markets, research, and engineering converge.

I work where financial markets, quantitative analysis, and technology converge. My current mandate is institutional OTC execution across digital assets and FX — quoting on a basis-point pricing framework, optimising spreads and VWAP execution, and running cross-venue arbitrage and market-neutral hedging across exchanges, liquidity venues and FX providers. Before trading, I spent two years engineering Global Markets and enterprise systems at UOB, and held internships across GIC, Barclays, PwC and DataSpark spanning risk, performance analytics, FICC pricing and data engineering. I graduated from the National University of Singapore with a B.Sc. (Hons, Distinction) in Business Analytics with a Minor in Economics as an NUS Merit Scholar, and continue to deepen my quantitative practice through independent research in systematic trading, market microstructure and portfolio construction.

MARKETS

Execute

Institutional digital-asset and FX execution — bps pricing, spread optimisation, VWAP execution, cross-venue arbitrage and market-neutral hedging across the full trade lifecycle.

RESEARCH

Research

Systematic strategies, statistical arbitrage, portfolio construction, credit risk and quantitative modelling — validated walk-forward and net of costs.

ENGINEERING

Build

Global Markets technology, data pipelines, backend systems, DevSecOps and quant research infrastructure at enterprise scale.
